title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-12-01

ai_review.summary: Terrible audience‑heavy recording drowns a solid ’73 show, though the Playin' > Uncle John's > Playin' sequence shines.
ai_review.review: The consensus among reviewers is that this AUD tape suffers from horrible crowd‑filled sound and overall poor fidelity, making it almost unlistenable. Musically the night isn’t condemned – the Playin'>Uncle John’s>Playin' stretch is repeatedly praised as a highlight – but the recording quality overwhelms any appreciation of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers condemn the audio, rating it 1‑2 stars; only one brief comment notes a decent musical moment. The heavy weighting toward show quality cannot overcome the uniformly poor recording assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible crowd is described as 'horrid' and 'crowd‑heavy', with muffled instruments and overall awful fidelity; multiple reviewers call for a better source (SBD).

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; only the aforementioned sequence is highlighted as a high point.
